top_signals.title: Saudi-Backed Yemen Forces Begin Operation to Retake Houthi Areas
top_signals.summary: Yemen’s internationally-recognized government launched a full-scale military bid to recapture all areas under the control of the Houthis following weeks of escalation between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia. Bloomberg's Jill Disis breaks down the news. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z.  Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
top_signals.summary: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

top_signals.title: Pentagon Backs Ambitious Plan to Beam Solar Power From Space
top_signals.summary: Space-based solar power just got another powerful vote of confidence. The United States Department of Defense just inked a contract with solar energy company Overview Energy to “design, build, and test a homing beacon that will enable its space-based solar energy system to accurately beam power from orbit to receiving solar arrays on Earth,” according to a brand new report from Interesting Engineering. The idea is that solar panels would orbit the Earth, collecting sunlight straight from the source and then beaming it back down to Earth…
